understanding: Chip reset bring-up starts stable fixed-period clock on wb_clk_i before asserting asynchronous reset on wb_rst_i as first step before any configuration, tracking duration to symbolic P_fixed; quick-test-only active-high 10-cycle hold is testbench choice not documented DUT requirement.
preconditions: Symbolic period P_fixed selected for this test and held fixed with no dynamic switching during reset
Physical bindings CLK to wb_clk_i and WB_RST_I to wb_rst_i available for drive and monitor
No register configuration or traffic started; wishbone_slave_interface uart_serial_data modem_control_if hold DUT inputs idle and interrupt_output only observed during reset
Monitors sample wb_rst_i and wb_clk_i edges for reset duration tracking to P_fixed
stimulus_steps: START clock on wb_clk_i with period P_fixed before reset and HOLD fixed through reset
WAIT for stable clock edges for testbench stabilization limit
ASSERT reset on wb_rst_i to quick-test-only active level for quick-test-only hold of 10 clock cycles scaled to P_fixed; levels and cycles are testbench choice not documented DUT timing
SAMPLE reset assertion and clock edges on monitors to track reset duration to P_fixed
DEASSERT reset on wb_rst_i to complementary inactive level
WAIT for post-reset stabilization on clock edges before any configuration then CLEANUP to configuration stage
IF reset not completed within TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit THEN abort bring-up; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing
completion: Reset asserted then deasserted on wb_rst_i before any register configuration with duration tracked to symbolic P_fixed
Clock on wb_clk_i started before reset with period P_fixed and held fixed through reset
Terminate on reset done or TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing

facts.statement: WB_RST_I is asynchronous reset input for UART core
CLK is block clock input for UART core logic
After reset receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: After reset receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared

facts.statement: After reset Divisor Latch register is set to 0
facts.quote: The Divisor Latch register is set to 0.

facts.statement: After reset Line Control Register is 8 bits no parity 1 stop bit
facts.quote: The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1

facts.statement: After reset all interrupts are disabled in Interrupt Enable Register
facts.quote: All interrupts are disabled in the Interrupt Enable Register.
